styles.container: max-width: 740px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; font-family: "Comic Sans MS", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8 !important; color: #3f3f3f !important; background-color: #f8f0ff; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.innerContainer: background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96) 0%, rgba(248, 240, 255, 0.96) 100%); border-radius: 24px; padding: 32px; margin: 28px 0; box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(94, 124, 255, 0.18); border: 2px dashed #a5c7fe; transform: rotate(-1deg); transition: all 0.4s ease; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
styles.innerContainer::before: content: '✨'; position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 16px; color: #5e7cff; font-size: 24px; opacity: 0.6; animation: sparkle 2s infinite;
styles.p:
color: #555;
  font-family: "Comic Sans MS", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;
styles.ol > li: position: relative; counter-increment: item; list-style: none; margin-bottom: 20px; padding-left: 36px;
